register_ade20k_full_dataset: register the ADE20K-Full semantic segmentation dataset with detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for training and validation splits
get_ade20k_full_metadata: get the ADE20K-Full category metadata including 847 stuff class names and dataset-to-contiguous ID mappings
load_ade20k_full_sem_seg: load ADE20K-Full semantic segmentation images and TIFF annotations using detectron2 load_sem_seg with jpg and tif extensions
configure_ade20k_full_ignore_label: configure the ADE20K-Full dataset ignore label to 65535 for 16-bit TIFF ground truth images
customize_ade20k_full_root: customize the ADE20K-Full dataset root path via the DETECTRON2_DATASETS environment variable or a default datasets directory
